You start with 3 Lifes, and can take others Lifes... Maximum is 5 and if you reach 0 you are BANNED PERMANTLY
body:
# ASDF Plugin

**Welcome to ASDF. In this plugin, you start with 3 lives. If you kill a person, you can take their life. The maximum number of lives you can take is 5. If you reach 0, you will be permanently banned and can never come back.**

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43872bd5f824462b4e5b7a37a2895e1394e64fff.png)

## What is needed
- [PAPER](https://papermc.io/)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/DqzENyTW) _**Optional**_
